description: This source file provides the implementation of the ProductRelationshipDao interface for managing product relationship data in a database using JPA. It contains methods to retrieve product relationships based on type, group, products involved, and other criteria, employing complex JPQL queries with fetch joins to optimize data loading.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductRelationshipDao interface that manages database operations for product relationship entities using JPA.

methods.name: getByType

methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationships filtered by store, type, and language.

methods.description: Retrieves product relationships based on store and group identifier.
